people_visible: The couple on the sports field, facing each other; her back to camera in a white jersey numbered 11, he in a white t-shirt pulling a face
event: Joking around on the sideline of her lacrosse game, teams lined up in the background
notes: Hard-dated 23 April 2000 and completely unposed - he is gurning at her mid-conversation with her number 11 filling the frame. Same day as S006.

people_visible: The couple at a sports field; she in a white team jersey holding a lacrosse stick, he in a white t-shirt with an arm around her
event: He has come to watch her game; posed together on the sideline with the teams warming up behind
notes: Hard-dated to 23 April 2000 and shows the two of them alone, in her team uniform, at the very start of the relationship. Same roll and same day as S014.

people_visible: The couple indoors; he in the blue-and-white varsity jacket and baggy jeans, she in a navy sweatshirt, arms around each other
event: Posed together in a living room in front of a dresser with flowers and bottles
notes: High-school-era couple portrait, him still in his letterman jacket. Ties directly to the stamped 2000 material through the jacket and the room.

people_visible: The couple, both in formal dress: she in a blue halter gown with an updo, he in a pale blue-grey formal suit with a white boutonniere
event: Posed portrait before a school formal / prom, in a living room in front of a floral upholstered chair
notes: The earliest hard-dated picture of the two of them together in this batch, and the only formal-dress portrait of them as teenagers. The stamp '00. 5.10' predates the 2003 start date given in the brief, so this pair evidently goes back to high school.

people_visible: The couple hugging in the front seat of a car at night
event: Wrapped around each other in a parked car, lit by flash
notes: Very tender - her eyes closed, both smiling, faces squeezed together. One of several car-seat frames (S020, S022, S023) that together read as a whole era of driving around.

people_visible: The couple kissing, lying down; her hair falling across his face, a small ring visible on her right hand resting on his shoulder
event: A kiss on the floor at a party - a Coors/Bud Light can, a blue balloon and drum hardware are right beside them
notes: A completely private moment caught in the middle of a party - the couple alone, kissing, oblivious. Blown-out flash and grain, but the emotion carries it. Same night as S031.

people_visible: The couple in extreme close-up, lying head to head; he in a pale blue cap, she looking up at him
event: Lying down together, faces filling the frame, both laughing
notes: Grainy and slightly out of focus but emotionally the strongest kind of frame in the batch - the couple alone, entirely unguarded. No dating clues whatsoever.

people_visible: The couple lying on a carpeted floor among confetti and beer cans, heads together, laughing
event: The aftermath of a party - streamers and confetti all over the carpet, drum hardware and cymbal stands in the corner, cans on the side table
notes: Collapsed on the floor at the end of a party, still holding on to each other and laughing - the debris around them tells the whole story of the night. Same party as S049.

people_visible: The couple lying together on the settee inside a boat's cabin; she in a blue t-shirt, he beneath her grinning, striped cushions around them
event: Below decks on a motor boat - varnished wood table, galley sink and fridge visible, a drinks can on the counter
notes: Distinctive setting - a boat cabin - with the couple alone and clearly enjoying themselves. Rare location in this collection.

people_visible: The couple on the cabin sofa; he in a black beanie and white t-shirt, she in a pale blue sweatshirt, each holding a glass of red wine
event: Toasting with wine glasses in the cabin living room
notes: A wine toast, just the two of them, in a borrowed cabin - reads as one of their first trips away together. Print is slightly crooked with the curtain dominating the top third.

people_visible: The couple on the same patterned sofa; he in a white vest and backwards cap laughing upward, she curled against his chest
event: Lounging together on the cabin sofa, both laughing at something off-camera
notes: The laughing companion frame to the kiss in S026 - she is folded into him with her hands clasped in his. Couple alone, well exposed.

people_visible: The couple sunbathing in garden loungers; he shirtless in a white NY Giants cap and blue floral shorts, she in a pale blue bikini top on a pink towel, holding hands
event: Sunbathing side by side on a back lawn, hands linked between the chairs
theme: Young love; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Bright, sharp and warm, with their linked hands as the centre of the frame. Couple alone.

people_visible: The couple outdoors at dusk; he in a navy 'Pike 1868' t-shirt and a backwards Yankees cap, she in a grey hooded sweatshirt
event: Arm-in-arm portrait outdoors under trees, late afternoon light
notes: Warm backlit portrait of the couple alone, both beaming - technically one of the better prints here. The fraternity shirt is the useful dating clue: college era.

people_visible: The couple kissing on a patterned sofa; he in a white vest and navy backwards cap, she in a white t-shirt leaning into him
event: A quiet kiss on the sofa of a wood-panelled cabin or lake house
notes: The single most intimate frame in the batch: the two of them alone, mid-kiss, no audience, warm afternoon light through the curtain. Same weekend as S027, S028 and S029.

people_visible: The couple lying together on a single bed, she in a blue top with her head on his chest, both looking at the camera
event: In a dorm or student bedroom - the wall and floor are papered with beer and NFL posters (a Bud Light poster and a New York Giants poster are legible)
theme: Young love; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: The most unmistakably 'college' frame in the batch - a narrow dorm bed and a wall of beer posters. Print scanned at an angle with a strong colour cast.

people_visible: The couple on striped beach loungers; he in a bucket hat and blue floral swim shorts with a drink, she in a blue bikini
event: A day on a crowded resort beach, palms and beach umbrellas behind, storm clouds overhead
notes: Their first holidays together as a couple - relaxed, drinks in hand, on matching loungers. Probably the same trip as S032, S034, S035 and S040.

people_visible: young couple
event: She kisses his cheek indoors
notes: She leans in to kiss his cheek while he grins at the camera. Tender and very young.

people_visible: The couple standing outdoors by a pine tree; he in a pale blue dress shirt and dark trousers, she in a black halter dress with a beaded belt and necklace
event: Posed together outside before a formal event, his arms around her waist
notes: A proper full-length couple portrait in natural light, both dressed up and clearly pleased with each other - probably taken before a wedding or dance they were attending. Sharper than most prints in this batch.

people_visible: young couple
event: On a couch at a gathering
notes: Piled together laughing on a couch, drinks in hand. The college years exactly as they were.

people_visible: The mother in a white top and grey skirt and the father in a white tee
event: Posed together in front of an ornate dark carved wooden door, indoors at a restaurant or home
notes: COUPLE ALONE, dressed up early in the relationship - possibly a dinner or an event they went to together. Warm indoor cast, decent sharpness.

people_visible: The couple standing arm in arm in front of a yellow-sided house with a concrete stoop; a third person is cut off at the right edge
event: Posed in front of a house - possibly their first place or a family home - he in an 'RLX' sweatshirt, she in a blue top and white zip jacket
theme: Home; The life we built; Growing together
notes: The couple alone in front of a house they clearly wanted photographed - the strongest 'home' candidate in these four sheets. I cannot confirm from the image whether it is their own first house.

people_visible: The couple sitting together on a dark leather sofa, she in a black vest, he in a white t-shirt and blue shorts
event: An evening in at an apartment - acoustic guitar propped in the corner, stacked cases of drinks by the wall, TV remote in hand
theme: Home; Everyday life; The life we built
notes: One of the very few frames showing an actual home interior of their own - the empty walls and stacked cases say early, unfurnished first apartment. Good 'the life we built' opener.

people_visible: The father in a NY Yankees cap and white 'HOT DOG' t-shirt with the mother
event: The two of them alone at a night-time party or bar, his arm around her
notes: COUPLE ALONE, and one of the earliest frames of the two of them in the entire archive. Dark, noisy flash print, but the dating-years version of both faces is exactly what a 15th-anniversary film needs.

people_visible: young couple
event: Harbor visit, tall ship behind
notes: Arm in arm on a waterfront with a tall ship's rigging behind. Early dating years.

people_visible: young couple
event: He lifts her off the ground indoors
notes: He has swept her off her feet mid-laugh in a student room. Unguarded and young - one of the best possible openings for Chapter 1.

people_visible: The father in a white tank and the mother in a pale tank top
event: Sprawled together laughing in the back seat of a car
notes: COUPLE ALONE, completely unposed and laughing in a car back seat - very high emotional value. Faded, colour-shifted print with a blown-out flash.

people_visible: The father in a navy ball cap and white tank with the mother in red athletic shorts
event: The two of them at a marina, posed in front of a large white sportfishing boat, palm trees and a canal behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE on an early trip south; the scan is sideways but the print itself is sharp and well exposed. Their youngest faces of the whole batch.

people_visible: The father in a dark cap and swim trunks with the mother in a tank top
event: Sitting together on a boat deck or sandbar with drinks, two yachts anchored in turquoise water behind them
notes: COUPLE ALONE in the Caribbean/Bahamas on an early trip; genuinely beautiful light and water colour, one of the technically best prints in the batch.

people_visible: The mother wearing a 'Happy Birthday' tiara sitting on the father's lap
event: Her birthday celebration on a deck at night, he in a striped dress shirt, she in a bright print tube top
notes: COUPLE ALONE at one of her birthdays during the dating years - the tiara makes the occasion unambiguous. Night flash, heavy red cast on his face.

people_visible: young couple
event: On a beach lounger
notes: Sharing a lounger on the sand, relaxed and sunburnt. Same trip as S072.

people_visible: young couple
event: In the water in front of the Atlantis resort, Bahamas
notes: Standing in turquoise water with Atlantis behind. A strong candidate for the honeymoon or a major early trip - worth confirming which.

people_visible: young couple
event: Outside a pastel resort building, palms
notes: Embracing in swimwear outside a tropical resort. Early trip together.

people_visible: young couple
event: Marina at sunset
notes: Backlit by a marina sunset, arms out mid-laugh. Visually one of the prettiest early frames.

people_visible: The father in an academic gown and hood with the mother in a black dress
event: His graduation - a banner above them reads 'CONGRATULATIONS, GRADUATES' beneath a large ornamental clock, with balloon arches in the background
notes: COUPLE ALONE at his graduation with the ceremony banner readable in frame - the single biggest documented milestone in this batch. Black-and-white print, scanned upside down, but sharp and beautifully composed.

people_visible: No people - a wall covered in handwritten signatures
event: A signed wall reading '409 TAYLOR' with dozens of names written on it, above a pool table or bar rail
notes: '409 TAYLOR' signed by everyone who lived there - a record of a specific college address and the friends in it. Scanned upside down, low contrast, but the text is legible enough to read on screen.

people_visible: The father in a Titans #33 jersey and a long dreadlock wig, with the mother in a referee's striped shirt
event: Halloween costume party outside a brick bar, red cup in hand
notes: COUPLE ALONE in Halloween costumes; the burned-in stamp gives 10.27 but the year digits are unreadable at scan resolution. Funny, distinctive and well lit.

people_visible: The father in a brown suit with a boutonniere and the mother in a pewter/silver beaded dress
event: Standing on a brick sidewalk outside a wedding - he is wearing a groomsman's boutonniere, so this is someone else's wedding, not their own
notes: COUPLE ALONE, formally dressed, at a wedding where he was in the wedding party - a natural 'before it was our turn' beat for the film. Slightly soft, good daylight.

people_visible: The father in a Yankees pinstripe cap and jersey tee with the mother in a Yankees jersey
event: Cheek-to-cheek at a Yankees game or a Fourth of July ballgame party
notes: COUPLE ALONE with a readable burned-in date stamp of 07.04.2007 - one of the few hard-dated anchors in this batch. Very close crop, sun-flushed faces, matching team gear.

people_visible: young couple
event: Outdoors beside a car, drink in hand
notes: Leaning together by a car, both laughing. Date stamp makes this one of the few precisely dated early photos.

people_visible: The mother in a patterned halter dress and the father in a white dress shirt and black tie
event: Dressed up together in a bar decorated with a lit Christmas tree, under a Rolling Rock beer sign
notes: COUPLE ALONE, hard-dated 08.05.2007 - note the lit Christmas tree in August, so this is a themed bar night, not a holiday. Severe orange/red flash cast on both faces.

people_visible: young couple
event: Poolside/deck, he kisses her
notes: A kiss on a sunlit deck, drink in her hand. Precisely dated May 2007 - eight days after S067, so likely the same trip.

people_visible: The father in an olive polo and sunglasses with the mother in a pink top and sunglasses; a third person's hand and phone in the foreground
event: Posed together on the deck of a shore/beach house while someone else photographs them
notes: COUPLE ALONE at a beach house, with a period-accurate flip phone accidentally in frame - a strong incidental dating clue. Slight tilt and a foreground obstruction.

people_visible: The father in a red tee, sunglasses and a green 'GOT BEER?' novelty hat, with the mother in a green striped top and green beads
event: St. Patrick's Day, the two of them squeezed together indoors in green gear
notes: COUPLE ALONE, hard-dated by a burned-in stamp reading 03.17.2007 - the single cleanest date/occasion match in the batch. Very heavy red flash cast.

people_visible: The father and mother on a couch, she in a black-and-white print dress
event: Curled up together on a couch in an apartment with a flag or blanket pinned to the wall, beers in hand
notes: COUPLE ALONE in what looks like an early shared or friend's apartment, hard-dated 05.27.2007 and part of the same weekend as S089. Blown flash and a cluttered background.

people_visible: The mother in a black strapless dress and the father in a waistcoat, white shirt and tie
event: Dressed formally at an evening event - a wedding reception, gala or formal - both holding drinks
notes: COUPLE ALONE and dressed up, hard-dated 05.25.2007 by the burned-in stamp. Their most glamorous frame from the dating years; slight flash hotspot on his shirt.

people_visible: The father in a black suit and tie with the mother in a deep purple strapless gown
event: Seated together at a formal reception - other guests in suits visible behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE and the most flattering formal portrait of the two of them in the batch. It is a wedding reception, but the evidence does not tell me whose.

people_visible: The mother in a black one-shoulder top and sunglasses with the father in a dark tee
event: A day out on the Philadelphia waterfront - the blue Benjamin Franklin Bridge and a moored tour boat are behind them, with a Captain Morgan bar umbrella
theme: Adventure; Young love; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE with an identifiable city landmark behind them, which makes it useful for grounding the film geographically. Good daylight exposure.

people_visible: The father in a black bandana and tank top with the mother, sunglasses pushed up on her head
event: Close together on a boat or under a shelter on a hot day, both tanned and squinting
notes: COUPLE ALONE, very warm and relaxed with each other - one of the better later-era couple frames. Slightly soft and overexposed at the edges.

people_visible: The father with snow on his shaved head and the mother in a fur-trimmed hood
event: The two of them outdoors in falling snow at night, cheek to cheek, string lights behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE in a snowstorm, both laughing with snow visibly on his head - the most joyful frame on sheet 5. Flash-lit snowflakes cause hot spots but add to it.

people_visible: The father in a grey suit, the mother in a black satin bridesmaid dress with a bouquet, a second bridesmaid in the same dress, and another man in a grey suit and gold tie
event: Someone else's wedding - the mother is a bridesmaid, holding a matching white bouquet in a matching dress, posed outdoors with another couple
notes: She is a bridesmaid at another couple's wedding, with him as her date - a good 'in the wedding years' beat. Well exposed daylight and everybody sharp.

people_visible: The mother in a black slip dress and the father in a white striped shirt, shaved head
event: Posed together on a restaurant patio or courtyard in the evening, drink in his hand
theme: Young love; Growing together; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE, both looking straight at the camera and genuinely happy - the cleanest, best-exposed couple portrait in the whole batch.

people_visible: The mother and the father in sunglasses, at the edge of a resort pool
event: Leaning on the pool edge together in the late afternoon, towels spread on the deck
notes: COUPLE ALONE at the pool on the same holiday as S102 (stamps 28 and 29 on consecutive days). Nicely lit late-afternoon colour, no year in the stamp.

people_visible: The father in sunglasses and the mother, both in the sea
event: The two of them swimming together in clear turquoise ocean, heads and shoulders above water
notes: COUPLE ALONE in the ocean, both laughing - gorgeous water colour and one of the most joyful, filmic frames here. Strong hero candidate.

people_visible: The mother in a grey tank and the father with a shaved head and aviator sunglasses
event: Arm's-length self-portrait in a resort courtyard with tiled roofs and palms behind
notes: COUPLE ALONE, both genuinely laughing into the lens - the most spontaneous couple frame on sheet 4. Good light, slightly soft.

people_visible: The father alone, crouched and working, shirtless in the sun
event: Sanding or refinishing cabinets and drawer boxes outdoors in a driveway, a visible cloud of dust, a bicycle leaning behind him
theme: Home; The life we built; Everyday life
notes: Almost certainly a first-home renovation - the dust cloud caught mid-air makes it visually striking. Badly framed with him small and off-centre, but the story value is high.

people_visible: The mother in a black one-piece swimsuit and the father in a straw fedora, sunglasses and blue board shorts
event: Standing together in shallow turquoise water with the Atlantis Paradise Island Royal Towers directly behind them - the Bahamas
theme: Vacations; Marriage; Adventure; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE at Atlantis in the Bahamas, with the resort clearly identifiable - very likely the honeymoon, though nothing in the frame proves it outright. Sharp, bright and the best-looking print of the later era.

people_visible: father, mother, newborn
event: Hospital - birth of first daughter
notes: Hospital room, newborn in arms, both parents beaming. Irreplaceable - the exact hinge from couple to family. Chapter 4 opener.

people_visible: father in a team jersey and sunglasses and mother in a knit beanie, cheek to cheek in a selfie in a stadium
event: the two of them at a cold-weather football game - COUPLE ALONE, no children in frame
theme: Young love; Adventure; Growing together; Sports
notes: COUPLE ALONE - one of the scarce frames of just the two of them, grinning in the cold at a game. Phone-selfie quality but genuine, unposed warmth.

people_visible: Father in a white shirt and sunglasses bending over the baby in a high chair, mother laughing at right, a toddler daughter and a young boy in the background
event: First birthday party outdoors, the baby eating a cupcake in a high chair hung with a burlap 'ONE' banner
notes: The 'ONE' banner across the high chair pins it exactly: a first birthday, cupcake already in the baby's fist, both parents leaning in and the mother mid-laugh. Other party guests crowd the edges.

people_visible: father, mother, toddler daughter
event: At home, couch
notes: Toddler face fills frame, dad grinning underneath, mom leaning in. Unposed and alive - exactly the everyday register the film needs.

people_visible: father, mother, toddler daughter
event: Outdoors, overcast
notes: Tight three-head crop, all genuinely laughing. One of the warmest family-of-three frames in the archive.

people_visible: visibly pregnant mother in a swimsuit sitting on a boat bench with a small child in a life jacket beside her
event: on a pontoon boat on a lake during pregnancy, a toddler in a life vest tucked against her
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Motherhood; Vacations
notes: A rare pregnancy frame - bare bump, life jacket, lake water behind - documenting a family about to grow again. Soft, slightly blown-out phone capture, but almost nothing else in the archive shows a pregnancy.

people_visible: father, mother, young daughter
event: Formal event at home before going out
notes: Parents dressed formally, small daughter photobombing at knee height. Funny and true - a strong Chapter 5 candidate.

people_visible: father, mother, newborn
event: Hospital - birth of second daughter
notes: Second birth. Pairs directly with D001 - same framing, three years on.

people_visible: father, mother, older daughter, newborn
event: Hospital - first moments as four
notes: Black and white, hospital bed, all four together for the first time. Emotionally the strongest frame so far - the literal one-became-four beat.

people_visible: mother, older daughter, newborn, father
event: Older sister meeting the baby
notes: Shot from behind the older girl - unposed, quiet. Imperfect framing but a real moment.

people_visible: father, older daughter, newborn
event: At home on the couch
notes: Dad holds the newborn while the big sister holds her doll in the same pose. Accidental and lovely.

people_visible: Father and mother alone, cheek to cheek, a stranger walking behind them
event: Selfie together outdoors on a wooded path, the mother carrying a backpack
theme: Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
notes: The only frame in this batch of the two of them without any of the children. Relaxed, close and clearly taken on a day out on their own.

people_visible: father, mother
event: Outdoor event/festival
notes: Sunglasses, cheek to cheek, crowd behind. Rare post-kids photo of just the two of them looking like themselves. Prime closing-sequence material.

people_visible: father, daughter
event: Backyard
notes: Dad sprawled in a lawn chair, daughter in a tiny chair copying his exact pose. Genuinely funny - Chapter 5.

people_visible: Mother and father crouched behind their two daughters; the baby sits in a high chair draped in pink tulle, the older girl in a pink jacket leans in
event: Backyard first-birthday party for the younger daughter, high chair decorated with tulle and a crown banner
theme: Family of four; Parenthood; Milestones; Family growth
notes: The decorated high chair and the date (a week before the younger daughter's November birthday) make this read as her first-birthday party. Harsh backlight and a tilted angle, but all four are together and engaged.

people_visible: Mother and father with their heads close together, the toddler daughter held between them looking straight at the camera
event: UNKNOWN - a close indoor moment with the toddler, bright window behind
notes: Both parents' faces are turned toward the child rather than the lens, which gives it genuine warmth. Only one of the two daughters appears.

people_visible: Father lying back in shallow pool water lifting the toddler daughter overhead; two other figures, one appearing to be the older daughter, are in the water behind them
event: Play in a shallow pool - the father launching the toddler into the air
notes: Unusual overhead-into-water composition; the child is mid-air with legs kicking. The background figures are too small to identify with certainty.

people_visible: father in a beanie and a young girl in a red crocheted hat, both sticking their tongues out in a selfie
event: father-daughter clowning selfie, outdoors in winter clothing
notes: Both of them pulling the same face at arm's length - the relationship is the whole photo. Awkward selfie crop and blown-out background.

people_visible: Mother in a grey knit beanie, a toddler in a pink bear-ear hat between them, and father in a hooded sweatshirt and cap taking the selfie
event: Autumn walk outdoors, parents grinning over their shoulders with the bundled toddler between them
notes: Both parents caught mid-laugh with the toddler deadpan between them and full autumn colour behind. Only the youngest child in frame; the others are not in the picture.

people_visible: father with a girl on his shoulders, a woman in an elf costume, a man dressed as Santa, and a woman holding a small child
event: an in-home Santa visit - Santa and an elf posing with the family by the fireplace and tree
notes: A hired Santa and elf standing in the living room with the family - an unusual, very datable holiday ritual. Busy, dim room and a bit of a lineup composition.

people_visible: mother holding a toddler girl, father holding an older girl, in front of a decorated Christmas tree
event: Christmas portrait in front of the tree, parents each holding a daughter
notes: Classic tree-side four-person portrait, father in a red sweater, both girls carried. Slightly warm indoor light but everyone is looking at the camera and smiling.

people_visible: one girl, about 3, sitting cross-legged on the carpet surrounded by scattered board games and papers
event: a child has emptied every board game box across the family room floor
notes: The wreckage of a dozen game boxes with one small culprit sitting calmly in the middle of it. Wide, plain snapshot but the story is complete in one glance.

people_visible: Mother, father in a flat cap, and two young daughters in matching pyjamas at a party table; a shop worker in a red apron and other guests behind
event: Birthday party at a doughnut shop, one daughter balancing a doughnut on her head while the other reaches for the whipped cream

notes: A doughnut is balanced on one daughter's head and her mouth is wide open with glee while the other reaches into the cream. Balloon tablecloth, doughnut cake stacks, both parents laughing behind them.

people_visible: mother in a denim shirt and father in a navy shirt and sunglasses, standing together on a lawn
event: the two of them posing outdoors on a spring day - COUPLE ALONE
theme: Marriage; Growing together; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE - the parents' own portrait from a family photo day, arms around each other in the spring sun. Cleanly lit and sharp; scarce because they are almost never photographed without the kids.

people_visible: Father carrying the younger daughter on his hip and mother with her arms around the older daughter, all four pressed together on a beach
event: Day at a lakefront beach with a lifeguard chair and buildings behind
notes: Best-lit group frame of the batch: all four faces clear, everyone physically connected. Same day as the distant beach shot with the skyline.

people_visible: Father in a light blue suit, mother in a navy striped dress, and both daughters in white tulle flower-girl dresses on a green lawn
event: A wedding at which both daughters served as flower girls
theme: Marriage; Family of four; Milestones; Holidays
notes: Technically the cleanest frame in the batch - even shade, sharp, well composed. Formal and posed, but the flower-girl dresses mark a specific family occasion.

people_visible: The two daughters alone in their flower-girl dresses, walking across a lawn carrying petal baskets
event: The girls walking out as flower girls at a wedding
notes: Shot from a distance across open grass, the two of them small and alone in their matching dresses - quiet and cinematic. Slightly soft focus.

people_visible: The two daughters standing arm in arm on a wet driveway in first-day outfits, one holding a name card
event: First day of school, the sisters hugging before leaving
notes: Black and white on a rain-dark driveway, older sister's arm around the younger one - a clean marker of a school-year transition. Part of a four-photo first-day sequence taken that morning.

people_visible: The older daughter alone, jumping with arms flung wide, backpack on, beside the 'first day' sign
event: First day of school - the older daughter leaping in the driveway
notes: Caught mid-jump with both feet off the pavement, which sells the excitement better than the posed frames from the same morning. Distant framing, motion-soft.

people_visible: The father in a suit holding a young daughter in a tutu who has slumped her head onto his shoulder; other guests and children are behind them
event: Late in an event reception under purple uplighting - the child is worn out and being carried
notes: Heavily purple-cast and grainy from the dance-floor lighting, but the child's exhausted face on her father's shoulder is the strongest emotional read on this sheet. Do not discard for the color.

people_visible: Father asleep on a sectional couch with a daughter asleep sprawled across his chest and legs
event: Both father and daughter passed out asleep on the living room couch
theme: Fatherhood; Home; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Unposed and clearly taken by whoever walked in on it - the day after the wedding-reception frames. Ordinary living-room clutter and flat light, which is part of its honesty.

people_visible: The two daughters seen from behind with their hands pressed against a glass storm door, an older grey-haired man standing outside on the walkway holding something out toward them
event: A visit conducted through a closed glass door - the girls at the glass, an older relative kept outside on the path
theme: Family growth; Home; Growing older; The life we built
notes: Late March 2020 and a doorway visit with the glass between them - the single most historically specific frame in this batch. The girls' small hands flat on the door do all the work; shot from inside so they are silhouetted.

people_visible: Father balancing on one leg in the living room following a video on the TV, with both daughters copying the pose behind him
event: Following an exercise or dance video at home, all three mid-pose in front of the television
theme: Fatherhood; Home; Humor; Everyday life; Chaos
notes: Furniture pushed aside and a screen-led workout in the living room - very much spring 2020 at home. Motion blur on the girls, which suits it.

people_visible: Mother (dark hair) in a selfie on a wooden dock with two young daughters, one in a pink bike helmet, one in a white hoodie
event: Rest stop on a dock over the water during a bike ride
notes: Easy, unforced smiles; the still-buckled pink helmet dates it to the middle of an outing rather than a posed stop. Water and dock planks give it depth.

people_visible: Father walking hand-in-hand with a young daughter toward the water; a second child crouched on the shore behind them
event: Walking down to the edge of a lake
notes: Backs to the camera, the held hand at the center of the frame, wide empty lake and treeline beyond. Reads as a classic parent-and-child silhouette without being posed.

people_visible: Two daughters leaning over a car seat back with their faces close to the lens; the father grinning between the headrests behind them
event: Goofing around in the car, faces crammed into a selfie
notes: A grey headrest blocks the bottom third and the exposure is flat, but the squeezed-shut eyes and the father's grin behind make it genuinely funny. Keep despite the technical mess.

people_visible: Father in a 'my favorite people call me dad' shirt and mother in a pink tie-dye top, both in purple face masks, leaning over a newborn strapped into an infant car seat
event: Discharge day at the hospital, the parents with their newborn daughter buckled into her car seat, ready to go home
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Parenthood; Milestones; Family of five

people_visible: Mother in Christmas pyjamas on the couch with all three daughters, the baby held on the middle girl's lap
event: Christmas morning on the living room couch in matching holiday pyjamas, mother and three daughters lined up
theme: Holidays; Motherhood; Sisterhood; Home; Family of five
notes: Mother and all three daughters in holiday pyjamas, the youngest still an infant being propped up by her sister. Dim indoor exposure and a plain couch, but it dates the family's first Christmas as five.

people_visible: Mother in a blue patterned swimsuit standing in the surf with two young daughters pressed against her legs
event: Standing in the shallow surf together at the ocean
notes: The girls cling to her hips with their backs half-turned while she smiles down the lens; low camera angle makes her the anchor of the frame. Physical affection, not a pose.

people_visible: Mother visibly pregnant in a floral swimsuit, father in blue trunks, and two daughters (one held on his hip, one standing in front)
event: Beach portrait late in the third pregnancy
theme: Family growth; Becoming parents; Vacations; Family of four
notes: The clearest 'family of four, about to be five' frame in the batch: the bump is unmistakable and both older girls are in the shot. A natural hinge point in the documentary.

people_visible: Masked mother with a small daughter and masked father with another daughter, seated on the front steps of a house with an infant car-seat carrier between them
event: Parents and daughters on the front steps with a newborn carrier, everyone in masks
theme: Becoming parents; Family growth; Home; Milestones
notes: Two weeks after the visible pregnancy, a car-seat carrier sits on the steps between the parents; the baby's face is not visible in the frame. The masks date it precisely to the pandemic hospital era.

people_visible: Mother lying on the floor with an infant in a 'Milk Monster' onesie on her chest and two older daughters in Halloween costumes stretched out on either side
event: Halloween on the living room floor with the new baby
theme: Holidays; Motherhood; Family growth; Family of five
notes: Shot from directly overhead with all four laid out in a row on the rug — the newborn's first Halloween, in costume, with her sisters. The bird's-eye framing is unlike anything else in the batch.

people_visible: Mother and one daughter cheek to cheek in knit beanies, snow and bare trees behind
event: Selfie together outside in the snow
notes: Tight two-shot, both grinning wide with matching pom hats; the closeness of the heads carries real warmth. Winter light is clean and even.

people_visible: An older woman in a black hat at left, a small daughter in a pink mask, an older daughter in a hooded coat, the father taking the selfie in a striped mask, and the mother in a green mask and white beanie
event: Family outing to the Rockefeller Center Christmas tree in New York, everyone in winter coats and face masks
notes: The lit Rockefeller tree fills the background while five masked faces crowd the lens. An older woman, most likely a grandmother, is with them; the youngest daughter is not in this frame.

people_visible: mother and father in costume posing together in a living room beside a decorated Christmas tree
event: a costume or themed party at home in December - COUPLE ALONE, both mugging for the camera
notes: COUPLE ALONE - the two of them in matching daft costumes in front of their own Christmas tree, clearly enjoying themselves. Ordinary indoor phone exposure but a rare, funny frame of the parents off duty.

people_visible: mother, father and two daughters crowded into a close outdoor selfie
event: an arm's-length family selfie in a park, everyone laughing into the lens
theme: Parenthood; Growing together; The life we built; Everyday life
notes: Four faces filling the frame, all four genuinely laughing - the warmest frame in this batch. Bright natural light and sharp faces despite the selfie distortion.

people_visible: Father laughing in the foreground with all three daughters behind him, the baby wide-mouthed with laughter at bottom
event: Arm's-length selfie on the couch at home, everyone laughing at once
theme: Fatherhood; Sisterhood; Home; Humor; Family of five
notes: Four open-mouthed laughs in one frame, the baby's the biggest of them. Soft, slightly washed-out phone image, but the feeling is completely unforced.

people_visible: Mother in a pink striped dress holding the baby in a white sun hat, two older daughters in front of them (one in a pink tutu holding flowers, one in a grey dress and a party hat), father in a coral polo and sunglasses
event: The whole family posed on a walkway outside a building signed 'Beaver Brook Day Spa', dressed for a celebration
theme: Family of five; Milestones; The life we built
notes: One of the earliest complete five-person frames in this batch, with the youngest still an infant on her mother's hip. The tutu, party hat and bouquet suggest a recital or birthday outing.

people_visible: an older girl standing on grass holding a toddler in pink pyjamas against her chest
event: big sister carrying her little sister outside among fallen leaves
notes: The little one has gone limp with her head on her sister's shoulder while the older girl braces to hold her up. Soft focus and a cluttered background, but the tenderness is unmistakable.

people_visible: father kneeling in a red polo between two daughters in patriotic outfits and hair bows
event: Fourth of July - father crouched down with both girls, same day as the mother-and-daughters frame
notes: Father down at the girls' height with an arm around each, all three beaming in the sun - the strongest father-daughter frame in the batch. Sharp and well exposed.

people_visible: Mother, father holding the youngest daughter in a sun hat, and two older daughters in swimsuits in front, at the ocean
event: Family beach portrait, all five together
theme: Family of five; Vacations; Family growth
notes: The counterpart to the pregnant beach frame a year earlier — same shoreline setup, now with the third daughter on the father's arm. Reads as a deliberate annual marker.

people_visible: Mother in a dark dress holding the infant in a white gown, father in a blue suit, and two daughters seated between them in front of a large flower arrangement
event: A formal indoor occasion with the baby in a white gown and ceremonial flowers, consistent with a christening or similar rite
theme: Milestones; Family of five; Family growth
notes: Everyone dressed formally and seated on steps with a sunflower arrangement behind; the white infant gown is the tell. I cannot confirm the specific ceremony from the frame.

people_visible: Father in a black 'Ken' T-shirt with three daughters in Barbie-print tops crowded around him in a kitchen
event: A Barbie-themed party, apparently a birthday, at home
notes: The dad wearing a 'Ken' shirt to his daughters' Barbie party is the whole joke and it lands; the toddler is pressed into the middle of the huddle. Kitchen clutter visible at the edges.

people_visible: The youngest daughter alone, a toddler on a grey couch in a 'Juicy' top, holding a lemon
event: Close portrait of the toddler at home
notes: Direct, unblinking eye contact with soft window light and a clean shallow-depth background. The strongest single-child portrait on these sheets.

people_visible: mother in a long strapless patterned gown and father in a grey suit, standing on a balcony above a river valley
event: dressed for a wedding or formal event, posing on the venue balcony - COUPLE ALONE
theme: Marriage; Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
notes: COUPLE ALONE and formally dressed - a rare grown-up frame of the two of them away from the children, with a river valley behind. Slightly distant framing but the setting and outfits make it a natural closing image.

people_visible: Father in the foreground taking the selfie, mother behind, and all three daughters, everyone in Christmas pyjamas
event: Christmas pyjama selfie sprawled on the floor of the playroom among toys and a ball pit
theme: Family of five; Holidays; Home; Sisterhood; The life we built
notes: All five of them piled together on the playroom floor in holiday pyjamas, every single face genuinely smiling and the toddler in the middle laughing straight down the lens. Grainy low indoor light does nothing to hurt it.

people_visible: Father standing chest-deep in clear turquoise water with both arms raised, the three daughters hanging off him and floating around him
event: Playing in the sea, the father hoisting all three girls at once
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Humor; Family of five
notes: Arms up in triumph with a daughter clamped to each side and the youngest floating in front in pink armbands — genuine, physical joy. Bright water, clean exposure, holds the screen easily.

people_visible: Mother and father in a beach selfie, both in sunglasses, big cloud-filled sky and turquoise sea behind them
event: Couple selfie on the beach on vacation
theme: Vacations; Growing together; The life we built
notes: The best-composed couple selfie of the batch — dramatic sky, both laughing rather than posing, a lone red beach chair anchoring the background.

people_visible: Mother and father close together at golden hour by water, he in a teal polo and aviators, she leaning into his shoulder
event: Evening portrait of the couple by the water
theme: Growing together; Growing older; The life we built
notes: Warm low sun turns the treeline behind them gold and both are relaxed and unguarded; the tightest, best-lit two-shot of the parents in this batch. Works as a marriage beat on its own.

people_visible: Father in sunglasses in a low-angle selfie with all three daughters piled around him; the youngest drinking from a cup, one girl in a 'Best Sister' shirt
event: Sitting outside together, the girls crowding into a selfie
notes: Four faces stacked at different depths and none of them arranged — the toddler drinks straight through the photo and the eldest leans in laughing. Messy, warm and unrepeatable.

people_visible: The three sisters standing in front of a cut Christmas tree at dusk, bundled in winter coats and hats
event: Picking out a Christmas tree at a tree lot in the evening
notes: Shot into a floodlit tree against a deep blue sky, so the girls are slightly underlit — but the annual tree run with all three sisters is a strong recurring beat.

people_visible: The father (shaved head) sitting propped against a tufted headboard reading aloud from a purple folder, with three daughters piled against him — one small girl in his lap, one tucked under each arm
event: Father reading aloud to all three daughters on a bed
theme: Fatherhood; Parenthood; Everyday life; Family of five
notes: All three girls are physically draped over their father while he reads — the whole family-of-five dynamic in one unposed frame. Slightly soft and casually framed, but the closeness is real.

people_visible: The mother alone, seated on the gunwale of a boat with her hair blown back, holding a straw hat in her lap and looking out to sea
event: Quiet moment on the boat, looking out at the water
notes: Rare solo portrait of the mother — turned away from the camera toward the horizon, wind in her hair, clean sky and sea behind. Reads as a breath in the middle of the trip.

people_visible: The father in a pink shirt and white trousers and the mother in a long white dress with a gold kimono, standing together on a resort path
event: Dressed-up couple portrait before a resort dinner
theme: Vacations; Marriage; Growing together; The life we built
notes: Full-length, well-lit portrait of the two of them dressed for an evening out, palms and colonial architecture behind. The strongest 'still a couple' frame in this batch.

people_visible: The father in a pink shirt walking away from camera at dusk carrying the youngest daughter on his hip, holding the middle daughter's hand, with the eldest in a white dress walking ahead
event: Walking back along a marina dock at dusk after dinner, all seen from behind
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Parenthood; The life we built
notes: Backs-turned dusk frame of a father hauling one daughter, leading another by the hand and following the third — motion-blurred and dark, but it carries more than any posed shot on the sheet.

people_visible: The three daughters seated apart from one another on the steps and edge of a large resort pool, all with their backs to the camera
event: Early morning at the resort pool before it fills up
notes: Three small figures spaced across an empty turquoise pool, all facing away — unusually graphic composition compared with the rest of the vacation take.

people_visible: The three daughters kneeling and lying in a pile on white sand at dusk, in swimsuits, laughing toward the camera
event: The three sisters playing in the sand at last light with the resort and palms behind them
notes: Wide, quiet dusk frame: three sisters tangled together on empty sand under a pastel sky and palm silhouettes. Composition and light both hold up for a long screen hold.

people_visible: The father, mother and three daughters standing in a row at the water's edge, small in a wide frame of sea and pastel cloud
event: Wide family-of-five portrait standing in the shallows at sunset
theme: Vacations; Family of five; The life we built
notes: The five of them small against a big soft sky and turquoise water — the most cinematic of the several family beach frames from this evening.

people_visible: one girl, roughly 11 to 13, in a blue lacrosse jersey holding her stick across her shoulders in a white-background studio portrait
event: a posed studio sports portrait in club uniform
notes: A confident, cleanly lit studio portrait in full kit - the clearest 'she grew up' frame in the batch. Technically the best exposure and focus on these sheets.

people_visible: The mother in a knit beanie reading MAMA, cheek to cheek in a selfie with the youngest daughter in a pale pink pom-pom hat
event: Cold-weather selfie of mother and youngest daughter, both bundled in coats and hats
theme: Motherhood; Parenthood; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Both faces fill the frame in real winter light, the little girl grinning wide-eyed under a pom hat. The MAMA beanie does a lot of narrative work for free.

people_visible: The mother in a Santa hat and a young daughter in white dragging a cut fir tree toward camera, the father at right holding the saw aloft, and one more person behind them
event: Cutting down a Christmas tree at a tree farm and hauling it out of the rows
notes: Mid-action frame: the tree is down and being dragged, the father is brandishing the saw like a trophy. A fourth figure behind the tree is too obscured to identify.

people_visible: A young girl in a white knit hat and lilac coat grinning open-mouthed at the camera holding a wrapped Christmas gift; two adults stand blurred behind her
event: A daughter outdoors holding a wrapped Christmas present, apparently mid-delivery or exchange
notes: Big unguarded grin filling the frame, gift held out in both hands. The two adults behind are out of focus and not identifiable.

people_visible: An older daughter kneeling at a round coffee table across from a younger sister, playing a game with red plastic cups; Christmas tree and stockings behind
event: Two sisters playing a cup game in the living room on Christmas Eve
notes: Unposed Christmas Eve texture — two sisters absorbed in a game across a coffee table with the decorated room around them. Wide and a bit cluttered, but genuinely candid.

people_visible: The father and the youngest daughter side by side, both sticking their tongues out and crossing their eyes for the camera, in a busy shop or ice-cream counter
event: Silly face-pulling selfie with a striped drink cup on the counter beside them
theme: Humor; Fatherhood; Everyday life; Growing together
notes: Father and daughter pulling identical goofy faces, tongues out — the mirroring is the whole point and it lands. Busy background, but the two of them dominate.

people_visible: The mother in a cap reading MOM of GIRLS, cheek to cheek in a selfie with a beaming daughter wearing a rainbow candy-bead necklace
event: Outdoor selfie of mother and daughter, the girl grinning with a candy necklace on
notes: Enormous open-mouthed grin from the daughter against her mother's cheek, and the cap literally spells out the household. Bright natural light, tight crop.

people_visible: The mother between two daughters, all three cheek to cheek in a close selfie; the younger girl is missing her front teeth
event: Close selfie of mother and two daughters, dressed up indoors in bright window light
notes: Three faces filling the frame, all laughing, gap-toothed grin on the younger girl dating the year precisely. Taken on the same dressed-up day as the church-steps frames.

people_visible: The mother, the father in a tan suit and sunglasses, and the three daughters on the steps of a brick church, the middle-sized girl in a long white dress
event: Family portrait on the church steps after what appears to be a First Communion or similar church milestone for one daughter
theme: Milestones; Family of five; Parenthood; Growing older
notes: All five dressed up on the church steps with one daughter in the white ceremonial dress — the clearest milestone frame of the batch. Posed and squinting into sun, but unambiguous.

people_visible: The mother reclining in a patio chair reading a handmade card, with a young daughter in a swimsuit beside her, mouth open mid-shout
event: Mother reading a card from her daughter on the back porch while the girl reacts
notes: Wholly unposed: the mother is actually reading the card while the daughter yells something at her from a foot away. Dim porch light and awkward framing, but the moment is real.

people_visible: The father, shirtless in a ball cap, standing on a lake dock with all three daughters in red-white-and-blue swimsuits clustered around him
event: Fourth of July at the lake, posing on the dock before swimming
theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Holidays; Family of five
notes: Dad on the dock with all three girls in patriotic suits, the youngest tucked in front of him; open water and hills behind make a clean, warm frame.

people_visible: All three daughters standing barefoot on a lawn by the lake, each holding a large red heart-shaped award plaque; the oldest wears a novelty headband, and a boy is partly cut off at the left edge
event: Awards night at a lake camp or club; each girl holds the plaque she was given, one reading 'Best Sportsmanship'
notes: All three girls holding hand-painted awards with their names on them at the lake; the specificity of the plaques makes this a real milestone frame rather than a generic group pose.

people_visible: The father seated indoors, laughing, with dozens of small jewel stickers stuck all over his bald head and face; a daughter's hands are reaching in to place more, and the mother stands beside him
event: The girls decorating dad's bald head with rhinestone stickers while he sits and takes it
notes: Completely unrepeatable: dad's shaved head covered in gem stickers, hands still working on him, everyone laughing. Indoor light is mediocre and it doesn't matter.

people_visible: Black-and-white close-up of one daughter's face in profile-ish three-quarter view, hair wet and braided, looking off past the camera
event: UNKNOWN — a quiet unposed portrait, apparently outdoors near water
notes: The only true portrait in this batch: tight black-and-white frame of one of the middle-aged-child faces, pensive and unaware of the lens. Holds a screen easily.

people_visible: The whole family seated along a table under a gold number-5 balloon and HAPPY B-DAY letters: mother, father and the three daughters, with a small cake in front of the birthday girl
event: The youngest daughter's fifth birthday at home
theme: Milestones; Family of five; Holidays; Home; Parenthood
notes: Dated birthday marker for the youngest — the gold '5' pins her age, which anchors the family timeline. Everyone in one frame at the same table.

people_visible: The mother and two daughters leaning in behind a lit birthday cake in a dark kitchen, faces lit from below by the candles
event: Birthday candles being lit before the song, in a darkened room
notes: Candlelight-only exposure with the three faces glowing over the cake; noisy and dim by design, and the warmth of it is the whole point.

people_visible: One daughter in a navy lacrosse jersey standing inside a backyard net with the youngest daughter in front of her, both holding lacrosse sticks
event: Backyard lacrosse — the older sister setting up in the goal with the little one copying her
notes: The sport passing down a generation inside the family in one frame: big sister in full kit, tiny sister with her own stick, same backyard goal.

people_visible: The whole family in Halloween costumes indoors: the father in a football uniform with face paint, the mother in a patterned outfit with a red headband, and the three daughters costumed, the youngest wearing a sash and carrying a trick-or-treat bag
event: Halloween night, posed in costume before trick-or-treating
theme: Holidays; Family of five; Humor; Home
notes: All five in costume in one hallway frame, dad committed all the way to face paint; the annual Halloween lineup with everyone still willing to participate.

people_visible: Close-up of one daughter in red plaid pajamas with her mouth wide open in surprise, an adult in a Christmas sweater seated beside her at the edge of frame
event: Reacting to a gift on Christmas Eve — caught mid-gasp
notes: Pure unguarded reaction shot: eyes wide, mouth open, caught the exact instant. Indoor light is warm and slightly soft but the expression carries it.

people_visible: Two daughters photographed from behind in teal pinnies with the family surname and numbers 4 and 5 on their backs, standing in a backyard in front of a portable goal
event: Backyard lacrosse practice, the two sisters facing the net together
notes: Same surname, different numbers, shot from behind — reads as two sisters on the same team without needing faces. Quiet and specific.

people_visible: One daughter lying spread-eagle on the grass holding a lacrosse stick, above the letters A E C spelled out on the field in lacrosse balls
event: Goofing on the field after practice, having spelled out initials with the ball bucket
notes: Overhead composition with the balls spelling initials and the girl flopped starfish-style above them; the most inventive single frame in the sports run.

people_visible: All three daughters photographed from behind on a grass field, wearing teal team jerseys with the family surname and numbers 5, 11 and 4
event: The three sisters standing together on the field in their team jerseys, backs to the camera
theme: Sports; Sisterhood; Family of five; The life we built; Growing together
notes: All three girls in the same surname on their backs, tallest to smallest, facing the field they all play on. Anonymous faces make it universal — the single best summary frame of where this family has arrived.

people_visible: All three daughters, in matching black lacrosse pinnies numbered 5, 11 and 4 with the family surname across the back, looking back over their shoulders
event: The three sisters standing together at the edge of a large open grass lacrosse field, turned to look back at the camera
theme: Sisterhood; Sports; Growing older; Growing together
notes: Black-and-white frame of the three sisters in identical family-name jerseys, tallest to smallest, glancing back across a huge empty field. It reads as one image of the whole sibling set and of the sport that runs through this stretch of the archive.

people_visible: Two of the daughters on the front step; the taller one in a denim overall dress holding a 'LAST DAY!' sign, her arm around the younger one in a blue tee and pink shorts
event: Last-day-of-school portrait at the front door, the two girls holding the sign together
notes: The older sister's arm is pulled protectively around the younger one and both are laughing at whoever is holding the camera. Same day as D226, but this one carries the relationship.

people_visible: The two younger daughters in matching grey camp shirts and stick-on bear ears, each holding a basketball, with face paint on their noses
event: Basketball camp in a school gym, the two of them mugging with balls held up
notes: Bear ears, painted noses and two enormous grins in an empty green-and-gold gym. Genuinely funny and clearly a camp day rather than a posed portrait.

people_visible: Mother in a purple tank with an iced drink, father in a white polo and cap taking the selfie, and all three daughters
event: Family selfie at a professional golf tournament beside the water on a bright day
theme: Family of five; Vacations; Sports; The life we built
notes: All five faces crowded into one arm's-length frame, everyone genuinely laughing, tournament flags and a pond behind. The middle daughter's braces date it precisely.
